_README: Symbol registry — overlays the hard-coded dicts in bot.py / core at boot. Schema in core/symbol_registry.py. Entries stay enabled:false (BENCH-LISTED: aliases unknown, signals 'unsupported') until the enable ceremony in config/README.md is done: broker offers the instrument, spec verified on the MT5 terminal, bridge deployed, then flip enabled and restart. tests/test_symbol_registry.py enforces that every committed entry is benched.

SOLANA.note: SPECS UNVERIFIED — placeholder values. Confirm instrument name, tickSize/tickValue, lot min/step/max and typical spread in the MT5 spec window before enabling.

CARDANO.note: SPECS UNVERIFIED — placeholder values. Confirm on the MT5 terminal before enabling. Expect long flat stretches; per-symbol stats stay separate (n<20 = provisional).
